name: Beau
source:
Beau is an adventurer. A free spirited, wise cracking, good hearted rogue who's always looking for inspiration and challenge. She is amazingly resourceful, sourcing all of her tools, weapons, and toys from drum roll please... boxes. She's exceptionally proud of the whip she's fashioned from that extension cord you stuck in the garage when you realized you already owned three. You should go on any adventure she pitches - this is a box that won't fall apart on the way from the car.
Likes: Vim, Vigor, Derring-do
Dislikes: Dishonesty, Cowardice, Reliquary Theft

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
